item.title: Little Rock Zoo’s oldest gorilla, Catherine, dies at 42
item.description: LITTLE ROCK, Ark. — Catherine, the Little Rock Zoo’s oldest gorilla and a longtime favorite among visitors, died Monday after complications from heart failure, the Zoo announced Saturday. item.title: Five-year-old Arkansas boy Bo Henry overcomes devastating injuries to pursue dream of being a cowboy
item.description: Bo Henry Fryar, a young boy who lost his mother and sister in a car accident, overcame his injuries to become a champion team roper, proving that with hard work and determination, anything is possible.
